text:
endpoints/ contains 12 small Node modules. In each file, change the API_VERSION
constant from "v1" to "v2". Nothing else in the files should change. When you are
done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes.

arguments.command:
find endpoints -type f -maxdepth 2 -print | sort && printf '
-- matches --
' && grep -RIn --include='*.js' 'API_VERSION' endpoints && printf '
-- status --
' && git status --short

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
paths = sorted(Path('endpoints').glob('*.js'))
assert len(paths) == 12, f'expected 12 modules, got {len(paths)}'
old = 'const API_VERSION = "v1";'
new = 'const API_VERSION = "v2";'
for path in paths:
    text = path.read_text()
    assert text.count(old) == 1, f'{path}: expected exactly one v1 constant'
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
python3 verify.py

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
all 12 endpoint modules have API_VERSION "v2"
